processing: Lossless WebP atlas of reviewed artwork reduced to native size with nearest-neighbor sampling. The marsh bird was rotated 90 degrees clockwise to face east before packing. No frame pixels were painted locally.

rows.name: Narrow blue ripple
rows.style: Use only pale ICE BLUE and light gray-white, strictly no GREEN or yellow. Two slim nearly parallel widely spaced broken ripples and broad transparent center. A flat, restrained travel effect, tiny minimalist pixel clusters.
rows.prompt: One tiny isolated pale-cyan FOAM WAKE effect for a wooden boat moving NORTH. Overhead water-plane decal, no vertical relief. The narrow front starts at horizontal center near the TOP, with paired outward-slanting thin streaks and a dark TRANSPARENT opening between them, widening toward the LOWER HALF. A V opening toward the BOTTOM is the only silhouette. Pale blue-green and off-white foam on fully transparent background, including inside the V. No hull, oars, wave wall, reflections, solid blue water, scenery, text, black outlines, shadow or neighboring marks. HIGH TOP-DOWN orthographic camera, NEVER isometric. Native 16x16 hard-edged pixel art for TinyCiv. The existing reference is for pixel density and palette only. Keep a complete silhouette within transparent margins, no antialiasing or blur. Use only pale ICE BLUE and light gray-white, strictly no GREEN or yellow. Two slim nearly parallel widely spaced broken ripples and broad transparent center. A flat, restrained travel effect, tiny minimalist pixel clusters.
rows.animation: One isolated north-facing boat wake segment ages in place on the water. Keep the narrow front centered near the upper half and the V opening down. The two very thin pale-cyan arms spread slightly sideways, break into smaller streaks, and dissolve completely. Camera fixed. Transparent outside and inside the V. No boat, scenery, solid water, dark outlines, upright splash, new burst or camera drift. Do not translate the segment down the canvas. The last frame is empty.

rows.name: Black-tipped gull
rows.style: More natural proportions, long slightly bent wings, cream-white breast, pale gray back and tiny charcoal tips, muted clean pixel clusters.
rows.prompt: ONE tiny cream-white coastal gull pointing RIGHT, in flight with wings spread. High top-down view shows two separate long wings above and below a short body, a small right-facing beak and short left-facing tail. Wings pale gray with restrained dark tips. Clear right-facing silhouette, opaque bird on transparent background. No ground, shadow, other birds, text, scene or borders. HIGH TOP-DOWN orthographic camera, NEVER isometric. Native 24x24 hard-edged pixel art for TinyCiv. The existing reference is for pixel density and palette only. Keep a complete silhouette within transparent margins, no antialiasing or blur. More natural proportions, long slightly bent wings, cream-white breast, pale gray back and tiny charcoal tips, muted clean pixel clusters.
rows.animation: Tiny RIGHT-facing bird flies in place. One deliberate smooth wingbeat: long wings lift, spread, press down close to the body, then return to an outstretched glide. Keep the body, head, beak and tail stable in the same centered right-facing position, only the wings move. Full wings fit in canvas. High top-down orthographic, NOT isometric or side view. Transparent background, no shadow, other animals, land, motion streaks, camera shift or sprite translation. Smooth loop.

rows.name: Marsh heron
rows.style: Slightly more detailed and narrow than the gull, straw-gray color, elongated outline, clear species silhouette at 16-pixel display scale.
rows.prompt: ONE small pale marsh heron pointing RIGHT, viewed from above in flight. Broad gray-cream wings, a narrow gray body, small sharp beak at right, muted rust feet trailing at left, neck tucked on flight. Top and bottom wings both readable. Opaque tiny bird on transparent background, no ground, shadow, other birds, text or scene. HIGH TOP-DOWN orthographic camera, NEVER isometric. Native 24x24 hard-edged pixel art for TinyCiv. rows.animation: Tiny marsh heron flying RIGHT in place after takeoff. One broad strong wingbeat, wings fold slightly at the high point then spread and sweep down, return to the glide pose. Maintain the same centered right-facing beak, body and tail shape, wings alone drive motion. Top-down orthographic, NOT isometric. Transparent background, fully visible wings, no ground, water, shadow, extra bird, camera movement or body translation. Smooth loop.
